retired.name: Philadelphia International Cycling Classic (Philly Cycling Classic)
retired.reason: Defunct. The Manayunk Wall classic was last held in 2016; no edition since.

retired.name: Mt. Hood Cycling Classic

retired.reason: Inactive. The Winston-Salem Cycling Classic (UCI 1.2 road race + criterium) has not been held since 2023 as far as could be verified with reachable sources; no 2026 or 2027 edition found.

retired.name: El Tour de Mesa
retired.reason: Perimeter Bicycling's page states: 'We had a great ride in Mesa but decided not to continue this ride.' Last edition was the 30th (April 2, 2022).

retired.name: Skull Valley Loop Challenge (Prescott)
retired.reason: Suspended by Prescott Alternative Transportation in 2022 following a 2021 fatal crash and volunteer/resource limits; no editions since and no 2026/2027 dates.

retired.name: Bike the Bluff (Show Low)
retired.reason: Last held June 19, 2021 (BlueWolf Events); BikeSignup page reads 'Stay tuned for 2021 plans' and no later edition appears on any calendar read. Dormant/defunct.

retired.name: Hell's Gate Hundred (AdventureCORPS Death Valley century)
retired.reason: AdventureCORPS site: held annually in March 2009-2012 only. The Planet Ultra Death Valley Century (November) is the surviving event.

retired.name: Eroica California / Nova Eroica California (Cambria)
retired.reason: Replaced in 2026 by the Central Coast Classico, whose site says it 'replaces the beloved annual event Eroica California'. GranFondoGuide's 'Sept 13, 2026' Eroica listing is stale.

retired.name: Mt. Tam Double Century (Marin Cyclists)
retired.reason: No longer offered: the Marin Century's current route list tops out at the 127-mile Double Metric (37/64/94/102/127 mi); the 200-mile Mt. Tam Double no longer appears and the club's Mt Tam Double page returns 404.

retired.name: Amgen Tour of California
retired.reason: Pro stage race last held in 2019; never resumed (noted per brief; it was a race, not a participation event).

retired.reason: The Larry H. Miller Tour of Utah pro race was last held in 2019 and cancelled permanently; its Ultimate Challenge fondo ended with it. A revived 'Ultimate Challenge' ride was run by Salt Lake Criterium on Aug 15, 2026 (see events).

retired.name: Tour of Anchorage
retired.reason: Not a cycling event - it is the March Nordic ski marathon; no organized road-cycling event by this name was found.

retired.name: Paso Robles Cycling Festival / Great Western Bicycle Rally
retired.reason: POSSIBLY defunct (kept in events as tba): last verified edition 2019; no 2025/2026 listing found on the calendars read and the official site could not be opened. Needs confirmation.

retired.name: Harbor to the Bay
retired.reason: Ended — the 21st ride on Sept 23, 2023 was announced as the final Harbor to the Bay (Club Café continues its nonprofit work through other events).

retired.name: Red Ribbon Ride
retired.reason: Dormant/unverified — last confirmed edition Aug 2023 (2-day, Willow River MN). No 2024–2026 edition found; TeamRaiser page 404s. Confirm with The Aliveness Project before planning around it.

retired.reason: Not on the Best Buddies Challenge 2026–27 schedule (site lists Hyannis Port, Aspen, NY, Miami, Malibu Camp). Last held Sept 2025; status unclear.
